title: Acer debuts first Googlebook - the embodiment of premium, intelligence-powered hardware
summary: Acer today debuted the Acer Googlebook 14, designed for Gemini Intelligence and the first from the company in a brand-new category of flagship laptops bringing together premium materials, powerful…

blocks.text: Acer today debuted the Acer Googlebook 14, designed for Gemini Intelligence and the first from the company in a brand-new category of flagship laptops bringing together premium materials, powerful performance, intelligence features, and seamless syncing with Android phones.

Designed for the new Googlebook OS, the device works seamlessly with Android-based workflows and supports touch, keyboard, stylus, voice, and traditional laptop interaction methods within a unified user experience and help from Gemini at every step. The Acer Googlebook 14 is the industry’s first convertible Googlebook and provides users with groundbreaking new features designed to boost productivity and creativity by enabling context-aware actions for personalized, proactive help and a more intuitive, streamlined workflow.

“The new Acer Googlebook 14 puts intuitive and powerful tools with Gemini Intelligence at the fingertips of anyone wanting to boost their creativity and productivity,” said James Lin, General Manager, Notebooks, Acer Inc. “As a long-standing leader in Chromebooks since their inception 15 years ago, Acer is thrilled to continue our alliance with Google to launch this brand-new category of premium, AI-ready laptops.”

“Acer and Google have built an enduring partnership over the last 15 years, driven by a shared commitment to customer-focused innovation. As we move from a traditional operating system to an intelligence system, Acer is a critical partner in bringing this new category of intelligent computing to life,” said John Maletis, Vice President, Laptops and Tablets, Google. “The Acer Googlebook 14 pairs premium craftsmanship with Gemini Intelligence from the ground up, and we look forward to continuing our journey together to deliver next-generation computing to our shared customers.”

“Delivering intelligent experiences requires deep optimization across hardware, software, and the platform,” said Josh Newman, Intel General Manager and Vice President of Consumer PC, Client Computing Group. “Through close collaboration with Acer and Google, Intel Core Ultra Series 3 processors bring the performance, efficiency, and connectivity needed to unlock the full potential of Gemini Intelligence on the Acer Googlebook 14.”
Crafted for performance with Gemini Intelligence at its Core

The Acer Googlebook 14 is crafted with premium materials to handle the most advanced workflows. Powered by up to an Intel Core Ultra 7 processor 355 with built-in AI engines, including an NPU with up to 50 TOPS, the laptop delivers smoother multitasking, faster creation, responsive performance, and incredible power efficiency while providing users with the best of Gemini. High speed LPDDR5X RAM (up to 32 GB) and PCI Gen4 NVMe solid state storage (up to 512 GB) reduce application launch times, support large multitasking workloads, and minimize bottlenecks. The fast-charging battery provides up to 16 hours of battery life for all-day productivity on the go.

The Acer Googlebook 14 is designed to deliver Gemini Intelligence features, giving laptop users a whole new way to effortlessly manage their workflow and maintain momentum. For example, “Continue On” enables tasks started on an Android phone to continue seamlessly on the Acer Googlebook 14, while Cast My Apps makes Android phone apps easily accessible on the Acer Googlebook 14 without any installs needed. Additional features help Googlebook users get more done with less friction; proactive suggestions provide intuitive and personal help to users with context-aware actions and suggestions based on what is on the screen.
Gorgeous OLED Visuals in a Premium 1.14 kg Convertible Design

Every aspect of the new Acer Googlebook 14 was designed to take advantage of the unique features powered by Gemini Intelligence. For example, the new laptop’s immersive 14-inch 3K OLED display is the ideal palette for visualizing designs after activating Magic Pointer with a simple cursor wiggle. The 16:10 display, which is touch-enabled for intuitive navigation by fingertip or USI 2.0 stylus, features a Corning Gorilla Glass finish that provides resistance to scratches and damage. Powerful DTS®-tuned audio and dual upward-facing Acer Ultra Boost Stereo speakers compliment the display’s vibrant 500-nit brightness and impressive color accuracy.

Engineered from an ultra-durable aluminum-magnesium blend, this laptop prioritizes long-term durability, performance, and flexibility in a gorgeous Elemental Blue chassis. The expressive Glowbar on the top cover is a unique visual signature that gently varies colors and patterns to show the Googlebook’s battery life and charging status. Working on the laptop is more enjoyable with the Acer Comfort Touch treatment on the chassis’ palm rest and bottom cover, which provides a unique, silky finish that enhances grip and ergonomics. Even the typing experience is premium; the touchpad is both moisture resistant and covered with Corning Gorilla Glass for smooth navigation, while the keyboard is backlit for greater visibility in a range of lighting conditions.

The Googlebook’s convertible design features 360-degree hinges to enable four usage modes: clamshell for productivity, tent for streaming, stand for presenting, and tablet for scrolling and notetaking. Plus, its ultra-compact form factor makes it the ultimate companion for uncompromised mobility. A slender 13.9 mm (0.55 in) thin with a mere 1.14 kg (2.51 lbs) weight, the Acer Googlebook 14 easily fits in a backpack, bookbag, or handbags.

The Acer Googlebook 14 can act as one of the cornerstones of a connected life both with Gemini Intelligence capabilities as well as its hardware connectivity; it utilizes Intel Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 6.0 for fast and reliable wireless connections. The latest peripherals can easily connect via its Thunderbolt 4 Type-C port or the dual USB 3.2 Gen 2 Type-C ports, which are placed on each side for flexibility.[7] The 5 MP camera with noise reduction keeps appearances crisp and polished, and pairs with the triple microphone array to result in an excellent conferencing experience. Plus, the webcam’s physical privacy shutter promotes privacy. Additionally, the biometric fingerprint reader on the power button boosts security and provides quicker logins, while the Google Titan-C Security Chip provides an extra security layer to protect system integrity.
EPEAT® Climate+ Designation and Energy Star® 9.0 Certified

Crafted with 49% circular materials and 99% plastic-free packaging, the new Acer Googlebook 14 combines durability with a design to support Acer’s broader sustainability commitments and circular economy initiatives. Organizations and users that demand environmental responsibility along with first-rate performance will appreciate the Acer Googlebook 14’s EPEAT® Climate+ designation. In addition, the device is Energy Star® 9.0 certified and EPEAT® registered. It also features laser-etched labels that provide permanent and durable information, can withstand a broad range of environments, reduce visual labeling clutter and adhesive waste, and support easier recycling.
Twelve Months of Google AI Pro Included with Acer Googlebook 14

The Acer Googlebook 14 comes with 12 months of Google AI Pro. This gives Googlebook users expanded access to powerful features in Gemini, Flow, and Gemini Notebook, as well as Gemini directly in Google apps. Plus, it comes with 5 TB of cloud storage to keep photos and files backed up.
Pricing and Availability

Exact specifications, prices, and availability will vary by region. To learn more about availability, product specifications, and prices in specific markets, please contact your nearest Acer office via www.acer.com.
